text: To place a straight-line equal to a given straight-line at a given point (as an extremity). Let $A$ be the given point, and $BC$ the given straight-line. So  it is required to place a straight-line at point $A$ equal to the given straight-line $BC$.
For  let the straight-line $AB$ have been joined from point $A$ to point $B$ [Post.~1],
and let the equilateral triangle $DAB$ have been been constructed upon it [Prop.~1.1].
And let the straight-lines $AE$ and $BF$ have been produced in a straight-line with $DA$ and $DB$  (respectively) [Post.~2].
And let the circle $CGH$ with center $B$ and radius $BC$ have been drawn [Post.~3],
and again let the circle $GKL$ with center $D$ and radius $DG$ have been drawn [Post.~3].
Therefore, since the point $B$ is the center of (the circle) $CGH$, $BC$ is equal to  $BG$ [Def.~1.15].
assertion: BC is equal to BG (B is the center of circle CGH)

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: the point $B$ is the center of (the circle) $CGH$

text: Again, since the point $D$ is the center of the circle $GKL$, $DL$ is equal to $DG$ [Def.~1.15].
assertion: DL is equal to DG (D is the center of circle GKL)

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: the point $D$ is the center of the circle $GKL$

text: And within these,  $DA$ is equal to $DB$.
Thus, the remainder $AL$ is equal to the remainder $BG$ [C.N.~3].
assertion: remainder AL is equal to remainder BG

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: remainder $AL$ is equal to the remainder $BG$

text: But $BC$ was also shown (to be)  equal to $BG$.
assertion: BC is equal to BG (shown earlier)

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: $BC$ was also shown (to be)  equal to $BG$

text: Thus,  $AL$ and $BC$ are each equal to $BG$.
assertion: AL and BC are each equal to BG

text: But things equal to the same thing are also equal to one another [C.N.~1].
assertion: things equal to the same thing are equal to one another

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: things equal to the same thing are also equal to one another

text: Thus, the straight-line $AL$, equal to the given straight-line $BC$, has been placed at the given point $A$. (Which is) the very thing it was required to do.
